statements.status_notes: Account REST API partially disabled when --features-disabled=account,account-api is used. Five endpoints under /account/v1alpha1 remain functional due to missing checkAccountApiEnabled() gate. Requires authenticated user with API permissions. Waiting for upstream fix.
